q1.a: Creating and previewing are free. You pay when you publish, at the price of the design you chose.

q2.q: How do I send it to guests?
q2.a: Once published, your invitation gets its own link. Send it on Telegram, WhatsApp or by SMS — guests don't need to install anything.

q3.q: Can I edit it after publishing?
q3.a: Yes. Change the time, venue or photos any time; the link stays the same. Only the design can’t change after payment.

q4.q: How long does the invitation stay online?
q4.a: It stays online after the event too. A year after the event its photos are deleted; the text is kept.

q5.q: What happens to an unfinished draft?
q5.a: Drafts not edited for 7 days automatically lose their photos; the draft itself is kept. You can keep up to 30 drafts at a time.

q6.q: Why choose a digital invitation over a paper one?
q6.a: A digital invitation arrives instantly, with no printing or delivery: guests open the link and see the video opening, music, time and map. If something changes, you just edit it, with nothing to reprint.

q7.q: How do I know which guests are coming?
q7.a: The invitation has an RSVP form: guests say whether they're coming and how many people, and can leave a wish. Every reply reaches you on Telegram, and they're all listed in your account.

q8.q: Can I add music and photos?
q8.a: Yes. Add up to 6 photos and pick a song from the list or upload your own; it plays when a guest opens the invitation.

q9.q: Can I download the invitation as an image or QR code?
q9.a: Yes. A published invitation can be downloaded as a PNG image to print or forward, and as a QR code that opens the invitation.

about.title: Your wording's ready. Now the invitation
paragraphs: Even the best wording gets lost in a plain message. That's why more and more couples send their wedding invitation online: guests open a link and see a digital invitation with a video opening, music and a map.

Taklifim.uz is an online invitation maker built for Uzbek weddings. [Choose a design](/designs), fill in the details on your phone and send the invitation with one link on Telegram. More on this: [what is an online invitation](/articles/electronic-invitation).
